newsitem.title: MEXICO: Televisa, Television Espanola in DTH talks.
newsitem.headline: Televisa, Television Espanola in DTH talks.

text.p: Mexican media group Grupo Televisa said it was in "very advanced talks" with Television Espanola (TVE) of Spain to jointly operate Direct To Home television services.

"Television Espanola and Grupo Televisa announced they are in very advanced talks to reach an agreement consisting of operating jointly services of restricted digital television by satellite direct to the home, known in Spain as DTH," Televisa said in a statement.

"TVE and Televisa, the two most important companies in the world in Spanish-language TV production, will link their efforts to serve, among others, the Spanish market," Televisa said. "TVE and Televisa will be able to provide a diversity of programming never before seen."
"TVE and Televisa also announced that they are in very advanced talks with other potential partners so that they may join this important project," Televisa added.
